    when the bit is 0.

    """Return True iff there exists a selection of sets that exactly covers the universe.

    pairwise disjoint and their union equals the full universe {0,…,u‑1}.

    sets: List[List[int]] = instance["sets"]

                # If any element already used, not disjoint.
                if union & s:
                    ok = False
                    break
                union |= s
                chosen.append(s)
        if ok and union == universe:

    return False
